answer: The witness panel rotates every hour, so no single group of witnesses covers the whole event, and the prism of the design is that the rotation is driven by a public schedule nobody can predict in advance. The ferrous of the scheme is that an attendee must be confirmed by the panel on duty at that hour. A Sybil cannot target one friendly panel, because the panel changes, and the atlas of the rotation means a fake attendance would need every panel to cooperate.
